```mjs title=cjsBundle.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
var __commonJS = (factory, flags, id, isEntry, module) => function __require() {
	if (module !== undefined) {
		return module.exports;
	}
	module = { exports: {} };
	if (isEntry) module.isEntry = true;
	if (flags & 1) module.id = id;
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = false;
	if (flags & 4) factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports, undefined);
	else factory(module, module.exports, undefined);
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = true;
	return module.exports;
};
var require_cjs = /*#__PURE__*/ __commonJS(function(module, exports) {

/*!****************!*\
  !*** ./cjs.js ***!
  \****************/
exports.value = 42
}, 0, "./cjs.js");

const cjs_0 = require_cjs();
var cjs_0_default = /*#__PURE__*/__webpack_require__.n(cjs_0);
```

```mjs title=json.mjs
// ./index.json
var index_namespaceObject = {"foo":42}
var foo = index_namespaceObject.foo;
export { foo, index_namespaceObject as default };

```

```mjs title=main.mjs
// ./index.js
it('should have default export for json module', async () => {
  const { default: json } = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */'./bundle.mjs')
  expect(json.foo).toBe(42)
  const { default: cjs } = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */'./cjsBundle.mjs')
  expect(cjs.value).toBe(42)
})
export {};

```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/compat_get_default_export
(() => {
// getDefaultExport function for compatibility with non-ESM modules
__webpack_require__.n = (module) => {
	var getter = module && module.__esModule ?
		() => (module['default']) :
		() => (module);
	__webpack_require__.d(getter, { a: getter });
	return getter;
};

})();
// webpack/runtime/define_property_getters
(() => {
__webpack_require__.d = (exports, getters, values) => {
	var define = (defs, kind) => {
		for(var key in defs) {
			if(__webpack_require__.o(defs, key) && !__webpack_require__.o(exports, key)) {
				Object.defineProperty(exports, key, { enumerable: true, [kind]: defs[key] });
			}
		}
	};
	define(getters, "get");
	define(values, "value");
};
})();
// webpack/runtime/has_own_property
(() => {
__webpack_require__.o = (obj, prop) => (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop))
})();

export { __webpack_require__ };
```
